depictions.name: Nagahama Hachimangu Shrine
depictions.text: Nagahama Hachimangu Shrine is a Shinto shrine north of Nagahama Castle in Ōmi, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the shrine and prayed at four smaller shrines at the complex.
